title: "Session 15 · Resampling"
subtitle: "Bootstrap, permutation, and cross-validation logic"

## Learning goals

Distinguish three resampling questions, implement a bootstrap confidence interval
and permutation test by hand, construct leakage-free cross-validation folds, and
quantify simulation uncertainty.
